title: LRS limit revisions since the scheme began
sourceIndicatorId: RBI Master Direction on LRS, paragraph 2

metadata.method: Transcribed from the revision table in RBI's Master Direction on LRS.
metadata.assumptions: The limit is per resident individual. It is a ceiling, not observed remittance behaviour. From May 26, 2015 several current-account facilities were also subsumed under LRS, creating a coverage break in the reported totals.
